See footer.map.json / main.map.json for the model. layout/1 is a fixed <div class="pc-layout {class}"> wrapper around its `inner_block`; the inner/content/sidebar/main/footer structure comes from SEPARATE sub-components fed through the slot (container-only). Width constraints (pc-container-*) and the pc-layout--sticky mode are BODY-level classes, not attrs of this component. Shared SSR features: the body slot + the root class passthrough.
